name: Box Pistol Squat
cues: Stand on one leg in front of a box with the other leg reaching forward
Reach your arms out as you sit back
Touch the box lightly without settling onto it
Stand up through your whole foot

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: COM stays on the working midfoot (x -90 = -90, z -2). Working knee 92, hip 94 to parallel. The glutes touch the box with a 6 mm sink. The free leg stays straight and clears the floor (heel 49 mm up at the bottom). Only the working side moves the load, as expected for unilateral work, and the camera shows the box and the reaching leg.
